title: Ocean View Oasis Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Ocean View Oasis is a coastal retreat ideal for large families or groups. With private beach access, private pool & hot tub, stunning views, and four spacious floors of luxury; including a gourmet kitchen, home theater, game room, and sun deck.
description_expanded: Home Highlights: - PRIVATE beach access in gated community with 2 chairs and 1 umbrella set up daily for you March-Oct - Private heated Pool and hot tub - Elevator (residential elevator, not wheelchair accessible) - 6 Bikes included - Movie Theatre with theatre seating, popcorn machine, game room - Ping pong table in garage - Wifi and streaming TVs - 2 Fully stocked kitchens - Private driveway that will fit up to 5 cars - Walking distance to several shops and restaurants! - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. Welcome to Ocean View Oasis, a stunning multi-level retreat in the exclusive gated, Gulf-front community of Sandy Shores in Seacrest Beach, Florida — located on the beachside of scenic 30A with private beach access just steps away. Your stay includes complimentary daily beach service (two chairs and an umbrella, March–October) so you can sink into the sugar-white sand in style. This spacious home is designed for memorable gatherings, offering plenty of room to connect, relax, and recharge across four thoughtfully appointed floors — all accessible by elevator to the third level. On the first floor, you’ll find three inviting guest bedrooms, including a serene master suite, as well as a bright, open-concept living and dining area with a kitchen. The second floor is the heart of the home — a light-filled main living level with a seamless flow between the chef’s kitchen, dining room, and comfortable living space, ideal for entertaining. The kitchen is fully stocked and impressively equipped with high-end appliances, double ovens, and double dishwashers to make meal prep a breeze. Two balconies on this level invite you to enjoy the salty breeze, and three more guest bedrooms provide additional accommodations. Upstairs on the third floor, you’ll discover four more bedrooms and an additional cozy sitting area — perfect for a little quiet time. The fourth floor is dedicated to fun and relaxation, featuring a game room with foosball and video games, plus a home theater with a 120” screen and surround sound for movie nights to remember. Step outside to the sun deck and soak in breathtaking Gulf views along with panoramic scenes of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach — sunrise to sunset. Outside, enjoy your own private oasis with a sparkling pool, spacious deck, and relaxing hot tub surrounded by lounge chairs and a large dining set for alfresco meals. Fire up the gas grill for casual cookouts, or head to the garage where you’ll find a ping pong table, beach toys, extra chairs, and gear for fun-filled days on the sand. Whether you’re gathering everyone together or slipping away for some quiet moments, Ocean View Oasis is the perfect coastal escape where luxury, space, and unforgettable memories come standard. Accommodations: (sleeps 28) 1ST FLOOR Bedroom 1, Rosemary Suite: King bed. Private Bathroom with walk-in shower and soaking tub. Bedroom 2, Beach Bunk: Twin-over-full bunk. Shared bath with shower. Bedroom 3, Seaside Suite: 2 full beds. Private bathroom with shower 2ND FLOOR Bedroom 4, Serenity Suite: King Bed and Twin Bed. Private bathroom with shower Bedroom 5, Sunset Suite: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower Bedroom 6, Coral Suite: 2 Full Beds, Private Bathroom with tub/shower combo 3RD FLOOR Bedroom 7, Seaview Suite: Full Beds, Private Bathroom with tub/shower combo Bedroom 8, Coastal Suite - King Bed, Private Bathroom with tub/shower combo Bedroom 9: Seaglass Suite - Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with tub/shower combo Bedroom 10: Crew Quarters: 2 sets of full-over-full bunks and 1 twin-over-twin bunk. Shared bathroom with tub/shower combo. 4TH FLOOR Home Theater & Game Room * Sorry, no pets allowed. * Pool heat can be added for an additional fee of $350 * 2 Bikes Included with this rental through Sandpiper Vacation Rentals and 6 personal owner bikes. ** Please note the Beach Amenity Fee of $263 is only charged for March-October rentals. We will remove this charge during the off-season** *Certificate #091322 TDT#28042

Health And Safety: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
